# Kiran Krishnakumar

> Data Engineer specialising in enterprise-scale pipelines, lakehouses, and business intelligence.

## About

Kiran Krishnakumar is a Data Engineer (Senior Associate Engineer) at Ascendion, based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. He designs and delivers production-grade data engineering solutions using the modern data stack — Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Snowflake, dbt Cloud, and Power BI. He holds 6 industry certifications across Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and AI. He graduated with a B.Tech in Computer Science from VIT Vellore in 2024.

He is open to hybrid and remote data engineering roles.

## Skills

- **Languages:** Python, SQL, ECL, R, HTML, CSS
- **Data Engineering:** ETL/ELT pipelines, SSIS, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, dbt Cloud, Snowflake, Feature Engineering
- **Business Intelligence:** Power BI, Power BI Service, Paginated Reports, Tableau, Power Query, Excel
- **Databases:** SQL Server, SSMS, Stored Procedures, Data Modeling, Relational Architecture
- **Cloud:** Microsoft Azure, AWS, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, SnowConvert AI, SnowConvert Migration Accelerator
- **AI / ML:** Machine Learning, Data Science, Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, EDA, Statistics & Probability
